answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 11 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 580 identities costs 580 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The karst test is the live device, the zenith test is the locked stake, and the grove test is the graded history no template can fake.
